page.overview:
Who is Isengrim Took II?

Isengrim II Took was a hobbit of the Shire and the twenty-second Shire-thain.

Isengrim was the first to begin major work on the Great Smials in the Green-Hill Country where the Took-clan lived and where the Thains were seated. He became Shire-thain in TA 2683 (SR 1083). The Shire Reckoning was invented during his time in office. He died in TA 2722 (SR 1122) and the Thainship was passed to his son Isumbras III Took.
